lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration; spots are organized in approximately seven identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the spot centroids to form a primary grid-like anchor system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance blobs clustered primarily towards the anterior and dorsal margins of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) positioned ventrally to the primary pectoral fin and along the lower abdominal region.
